properties.label: allyl vinyl ether, lowest-energy conformer (pre-reaction minimum; unimolecular reaction, so the reactant complex is the molecule itself)
properties.method: B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP, gas phase, Opt+Freq, 0 imaginary frequencies
properties.note: Lowest of 10 verified conformer minima (cis/anti c4). Reference energy for the barrier; the IRC-connected conformer (gjf/irc_frame_fwd_optfreq.log) lies +2.34 kcal/mol above it.

properties.label: concerted chair-like [3,3]-sigmatropic Claisen transition state
properties.method: B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP, gas phase, Opt=(TS,CalcFC) Freq, exactly 1 imaginary frequency -459.4683 cm-1
properties.note: C1-C6 = 2.342 A, C3-O4 = 1.910 A, C2-C3 = 1.404 A, O4-C5 = 1.282 A in the saddle point geometry.

properties.label: pent-4-enal (4-pentenal)
properties.method: B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP, gas phase, Opt+Freq, 0 imaginary frequencies

edges.channel: concerted suprafacial [3,3]-sigmatropic rearrangement, chair-like six-membered TS

properties.barrier_definition: DeltaE# = E(TS1) - E(lowest reactant minimum), electronic only (no ZPE, no thermal correction)
properties.note: Atom map: reactant [CH2:1]=[CH:2][CH2:3][O:4][CH:5]=[CH2:6] -> product [O:4]=[CH:5][CH2:6][CH2:1][CH:2]=[CH2:3]. C3-O4 sigma bond breaks, C1-C6 sigma bond forms; pi bonds shift accordingly (1=2 -> 1-2, 5=6 -> 5-6, 2-3 -> 2=3, 4-5 -> 4=5). Gaussian LQA IRC from the same TS: forward path (rc 0 -> +11.44) returns to allyl vinyl ether, reverse path (rc 0 -> -11.42) runs to pent-4-enal; both outer frames re-optimized to 0-imaginary-frequency minima.
properties.reference_note: The barrier reference is the lowest verified reactant conformer (gjf/ave_cis_anti_c4_optfreq.log, -270.330333957 Ha), which need not be the conformer the IRC returns; the IRC reactant-side endpoint is the s-trans-gauche conformer (-270.326610113 Ha, +2.34 kcal/mol), giving 26.5 kcal/mol if referred to it instead.
